verdict.rationale: Evidence strongly documents a first-party Agent SDK for TypeScript/Node.js (createAgent(), session.send()/stream(), MCP tool support, browser/Expo/React Native variants) per letta-gh-1 and letta-docs-42/43/45/59/76/90, but the evidence pack contains no mention of an official Python SDK or parity of memory APIs across languages. Missing for 10: explicit Python SDK documentation, proof of equivalent memory API surface between Python and TypeScript, independent corroboration of cross-language parity.
